question: Which NMJ output populations transmit the persistent E078 body rhythm despite AVB inhibition?
method: Frozen full302-neuron closed-loop water simulation with selective NMJ release held at each neuron's own baseline mean during30..40s. All recurrent chemical/gap outputs, voltages and proprioceptive sensing remain live. Output release returns to live values at40s.
baseline_mean: Per-neuron sigmoid release mean over20..30s of hash-verified E078 selected ordinary sham

groups.head: RMD/SMD/SMB
groups.other: Every remaining neuron including AS sensory neurons; only existing NMJ edges contribute
groups.all: Global NMJ release hold diagnostic static-output control; never learned stopping

fixed: All checkpoint parameters, anatomical topology, known membrane properties, sensory/NMJ/body parameters and water mechanics. Original source files and checkpoints unchanged.
screen: Six ordinary cases on4 workers x4 physical cores
refinement: Rank non-global safe baseline-preserving groups by body-range reduction; repeat strongest group and sham on neural-half and body-half grids, four additional cases
checks: Model/trajectory/input hashes; coordinates reconstruct selected model; ordinary sham full trace or intervention pre30s matches original<=1e-8; paired same-grid interventions match pre-cue V/q; finite safe trajectories; compare during35..40s body/muscle raw ranges and recovery50..60s. Refined body/sham suppression ratio difference<=.05; report all failures.
limitations: Localizes rhythmic NMJ transmission, not neural oscillator origin. Mean-release holds preserve presynaptic tonic level but nonlinear muscle transfer can change mean muscle activation. Live proprioception can mediate secondary network changes. Population interactions/redundancy remain possible.
grouping_fix: Explicit motor classifier excludes ASG/ASH/ASI/ASJ/ASK/ASE sensory neurons from numbered AS motor groups in future E077/E078 schemas. Old models retain original saved schema/coordinates. Do not replay old latent vectors under corrected groups; full unknown-coordinate vectors still reconstruct old weights.
storage: Copied verified input capsule/model/coordinates/baseline mean, source reference path+hash; source/env/argv records; all10 diagnostic traces and metrics externally; minimum50GiB free before each trace write. No optimization populations or deletion.
qualification: No learned stopping, sensory control, swimming or biological qualification; all-output hold only a diagnostic control
